card.title: T-34 1942
card.flavorText: The T-34 was a legendary Soviet medium tank that had an unrivaled combination of mobility, firepower and protection when it was first introduced in WWII. Although better designs were introduced later in the war it is considered one of the most effective and influential tank designs of WWII. The T-34 has a crew of 4 (later variants had 5), a main armament of 76.2 mm F-34 tank gun (later 85 mm ZiS-S-53 gun) and a secondary armament of 2 × 7.62 mm DT machine guns.
